audit.whatIsWrong: Devour was called his W in three places ('W devour swallow your carry'), the page repeatedly said he 'has no dash to escape' while its own focus tracks Abyssal Dive, the Q stun was described as landing on the second hit, and the ult setup was credited to being 'invisible from W'.
audit.why: Riot's kit: W Abyssal Dive is the dive-and-reappear knockup, 21/20/19/18/17s, 1000-1200 range — that is his reposition. R Devour eats an enemy champion or shields an ally. Q Tongue Lash applies An Acquired Taste and stuns only when the target already has three stacks, and it heals him off champions. Neeko's Shapesplitter is a clone with no invisibility; the disguise is what hides Pop Blossom's preparation.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive named as his 21s reposition and the window it opens, Devour named as R, the three-stack gate on the Q stun stated, and the disguise credited for the hidden ult preparation.
sources: mirrorFindings: 'Three stacks buys the Q-stun or the Devour, not both'

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Tahm Kench levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items on a 72.73% lane whose own prose says those exact stages are Neeko's takeover. diff EVEN alongside a green tone, 4/10 and 'Favoured matchup'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill and matches whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] word for word; the layers were contradicting their own text.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 set to the packet order in both layers with matching ratings; diff EASY.

audit.why: Level 3 root window, level 6 Pop Blossom, first-item burst and his late utility spike are all present and correctly placed once the names are fixed.
Restated from the mirror: Tongue Lash stops on the first unit hit, so a Shapesplitter clone eats it; and any immobilizing CC — his Q stun or his W knockup — breaks Inherent Glamour.

By Level 3 you flip it: E (Tangle-Barbs) roots from 1000 and Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1, so root-into-Q-rebloom is a clean trade Thick Skin cannot fully refund. Sidestep the tongue and he has no other way to lock you for the all-in.

edits.before: This is your takeover. He's an immobile drain-tank who can't dodge a thing — your E root is basically guaranteed once you bait his Q, and Q's re-bloom shreds him while he sits still. Keep shoving with Q so his passive grey-health never gets idle time to regen between your trades.

At 6, Pop Blossom turns a landed E into a burst combo: stay disguised so the preparation is hidden, and note his Q only stuns once you carry three An Acquired Taste stacks. Keep shoving with Q — Thick Skin heals him out of combat, so never hand him idle time.
